Tuned vs Duplecast

November 19, 2026

Duplecast is a player for smart TVs and TV boxes that you try free for 15 days, then licence. Tuned is free on Android phones and TVs. Here is how they compare.

At a glance

DuplecastTuned
Where it runsSamsung, LG, VIDAA, Android TV, Google TV and Fire TVAndroid phones, tablets, Chromebooks, Android TV and Google TV
Playlist typesM3U, Xtream Codes, Stalker portal, and other panel loginsXtream Codes login, M3U link, M3U file, MAC portal (live TV and guide)
TV guideNot stated by the developerXMLTV guide as a list or a full grid, with reminders
Catch-upNot stated by the developerYes, on Xtream servers that keep recordings
RecordingNot stated by the developerYes, the channel you are watching (Premium)
Pause and rewind live TVNot stated by the developerYes, up to an hour kept on the device (Premium)
Several channels at onceNot stated by the developerNo, on purpose: one stream connection at a time
Casting to a TVNot stated by the developerChromecast
Picture-in-pictureNot stated by the developerYes
Offline downloadsNot stated by the developerFilms and episodes, whole seasons too (more than 3 at a time is Premium)
Profiles and parental controlsPlaylist passwords and parental settingsUp to 6 profiles, kids profiles and PINs (Premium); adult categories locked behind a PIN
TraktNot stated by the developerYes, scrobbles films and episodes (Premium)
Film and show detailsNot stated by the developerTMDB ratings, trailers, cast and actor pages, saved on the device
SubtitlesNot stated by the developerFull caption styling, timing fix, and subtitle search for films and episodes
AdsNot stated by the developerNone, ever
Price15-day free trial, then a yearly or multi-year licence (price not stated)Free, everything unlocked in the download from this site; on Google Play (coming soon), Premium US$9.99 a year with a 7-day trial, or US$24.99 once

"Not stated by the developer" means we couldn't find it on the developer's own pages or store listing. It may still be there, so check before you rule it out.

Price

Duplecast is free for 15 days with no card, then needs a yearly or multi-year licence per device. The page we read doesn't give the price. Tuned is free with no trial clock; Premium is US$9.99 a year with a 7-day trial or US$24.99 once.

Right now Tuned downloads from this site, through GitHub Releases, and that version is free with every feature unlocked, Premium ones included. The Premium prices are for the Google Play version, which is coming soon; they are what Play charges in the United States, and Play shows them in your own currency. Premium on Play covers up to three devices, and a Tuned account can add more.

Where Duplecast is ahead

  • Smart TVs from Samsung, LG and VIDAA.
  • Stalker portals for more than live TV.

Where Tuned is ahead

  • Free to keep using.
  • Phones and tablets as well as TVs.
  • A feature list we can point to: grid guide, catch-up, recording, live pause, downloads, TMDB pages, Trakt and subtitle search.

What Tuned does that most players don't

  • Opens straight to your channels. The playlist and guide live on the device, so the app shows channels the moment it opens and keeps them fresh in the background. Lists page straight from the database, so a playlist with tens of thousands of streams scrolls smoothly.
  • One stream connection, ever. The player, downloads, recordings, channel scans and backup copies take turns on a single connection, and anything in the background waits while you watch. Providers limit connections per account, and Tuned never uses a second one.
  • Live events from your guide. Today's games and fights are pulled out of the guide into one page. Tune finds a working English stream for an event, one channel at a time, and you can follow a team, league or fighter to get an alert before they play.
  • Backup copies and dead channels. When a channel has several copies, Tuned tries the next one if the first won't play, and a channel scan hides channels that never work, without blaming them for a slow internet connection or a busy server.
  • Real names over numbers. Episodes show their real titles from TMDB rather than "S1 E1", and tapping an actor opens everything they've been in, with what's in your playlist marked.
  • Sign in on a TV with your phone. Scan a QR code on the TV and type the login on your phone instead of with the remote.

Which one to pick

On a Samsung, LG or VIDAA TV, Duplecast runs where Tuned can't. On Android, Tuned is free and does more.

Sources

Checked on 19 November 2026. Features and prices change, so check the developer's page before you buy.
